role_policy: Whole original episodes assigned before recording or inspecting new labels. No role reassignment, favourable slicing, normalization or fitting from evaluation arrays.
braking_policy: Measure actual corner deceleration and braking coverage. Do not turn API cleanup braking into road-situation labels or claim longitudinal learning when positive braking is absent.
failure_policy: Stop after a failed original recorder or unverified idle teardown. Keep all completed and failed originals; no timeout-based replacement or automatic replay.
execution: Verified immutable local source snapshot; original NAS working directory and data paths. Local recording and durable requests, checksum archival after termination, retain local originals.
scope: New engine-AI teacher collection, not fly-policy driving, training, physiology or lap qualification. Existing30kmh/30s API envelope and controls unchanged. All camera pixels, native bytes, masks, source clocks and gaps retained. Game remains in background; no desktop input.
